# Transaction count lies. Profit per placement doesn't.

> Free calculator for independent ATM route operators: find real monthly profit per location after the surcharge split, processor fees, and vault cash cost of capital, then see whether your whole route hits your income goal.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
